title: Website changelog entry front matter
description: Front matter of website/content/changelog/<product>-<version>.md. The body uses the headings '## Added', '## Improved', '## Fixed' (any subset, in that order) and optionally '## Notes'. Validate with: node scripts/release/validate-json.mjs --front-matter shared/schemas/changelog-entry.schema.json website/content/changelog/*.md

title.description: Display title, e.g. 'VANTA Client 1.0.0'. Defaults to '<Product> <version>' when absent.

minecraftVersion.description: Minecraft version the release targets. Required for client and launcher entries.
